T: It's not the house. It's the snacks.
D: A family discover their comatose son's mind has wandered somewhere it shouldn't.
P: Serve the snacks when the ghost hunters set up their gadgets.
S: Specs and Tucker's homemade ghost-hunting kit
Corn chips, pretzels and cheese crackers tossed in butter, smoked paprika and garlic powder, baked at 150C for 20 minutes, tipped into paper bags labelled like evidence.
Elise in her gas mask at the séance in Dalton's room

Creamy devilled eggs whipped with mayo, Dijon and a little pickle juice, piped high and topped with smoked paprika, crisp bacon crumbs and chives. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp pickle juice, salt and pepper until smooth. Fry 3 rashers of bacon until very crisp and crumble. Pipe the yolk mix into the whites, dust with smoked paprika and top with the bacon and snipped chives.
the dark place Josh has to walk into
A smoky baba ganoush: eggplant charred whole over a flame until collapsed, blended with tahini, garlic, lemon and smoked paprika, with flatbread.
M: a family dinner in the new house
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato and red wine, layered with fresh pasta, béchamel and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes, rested 20.
Elise's chicken noodle soup with dill
the psychic who comes to help

Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and onion into a golden broth, with egg noodles, fresh dill, lemon and cracked pepper, crusty bread alongside. Put 800g chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2 litres water, 1 halved onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 2 bay leaves and 2 tsp salt. Simmer gently for 1 hour, skimming. Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and strain the broth. Dice another carrot and celery stick, simmer in the broth for 8 minutes, then add 200g egg noodles for 5 minutes. Return the chicken, add a handful of chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with crusty bread.
W: the red-faced figure in the corner
Sour cherries with sugar and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled and served with vanilla ice cream.
K: something dark in the other room
Muddled blackberries and lemon topped with soda, dark purple and fizzing over ice. Muddle 250g blackberries with 4 tbsp sugar and the juice of 2 lemons, then strain into a jug.

s.note: Specs and Tucker's homemade ghost-hunting kit
s.how: Toss 100g corn chips, 100g pretzels and 100g cheese crackers with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and half a tsp garlic powder. Bake at 150C for 20 minutes. Tip into paper bags labelled like evidence.

s.note: the dark place Josh has to walk into
s.how: Char 2 eggplants whole over a gas flame until collapsed. Scoop out and blend with 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Serve with warm flatbreads.

m.note: a family dinner in the new house
m.how: Simmer 500g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 tins tomatoes and 150ml red wine for 2 hours. Make béchamel with 50g butter, 50g flour and 600ml milk. Layer with 300g lasagne sheets and 250g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20.

w.note: the red-faced figure in the corner
w.how: Toss 800g sour cherries with 150g sugar, lemon juice and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: something dark in the other room
d.how: Muddle 250g blackberries with 4 tbsp sugar and the juice of 2 lemons, then strain into a jug. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the blackberry syrup and top with 800ml soda water.
